// (semaprax.public-generic-consumer-metadata.v1).
// Compiler-generated deterministic output; do not edit.
//
// This reads public generic *metadata*. It is not a calling convention: it
// receives no SEMAPRAX value, allocates none, frees none, and links against
// nothing. The declarations below show the substituted field tree in Rust;
// they define no layout, no ownership transfer, and no ABI.
#![allow(dead_code)]

const MAX_DEPTH: usize = 64;
const MAX_NODES: usize = 4096;
const MAX_FIELDS: usize = 8;
const MAX_RECORDS: usize = 8192;
const MAX_BYTES: usize = 1_048_576;
const MAGIC: &[u8] = b"spxpgcm1;";
const SCALARS: [&[u8]; 9] = [
    b"bytes", b"usize", b"bool", b"char", b"i64", b"i32", b"f32", b"f64", b"u8",
];

__DECLARATIONS__
const EXPECTED: &[u8] = &[
__EXPECTED__
];

/// A decimal count, without a leading zero, terminated by `stop`.
fn decimal(bytes: &[u8], mut at: usize, stop: u8) -> Option<(usize, usize)> {
    let start = at;
    let mut value: usize = 0;
    while at < bytes.len() && bytes[at].is_ascii_digit() {
        value = value
            .checked_mul(10)?
            .checked_add(usize::from(bytes[at] - b'0'))?;
        at += 1;
    }
    if at == start || (at - start > 1 && bytes[start] == b'0') {
        return None;
    }
    if bytes.get(at) != Some(&stop) {
        return None;
    }
    Some((value, at + 1))
}

/// One canonical grammar term. Returns the offset after it.
fn term(bytes: &[u8], mut at: usize, depth: usize, nodes: &mut usize) -> Option<usize> {
    if depth > MAX_DEPTH || at >= bytes.len() {
        return None;
    }
    *nodes += 1;
    if *nodes > MAX_NODES {
        return None;
    }
    if bytes[at] == b'@' {
        let (identity, next) = decimal(bytes, at + 1, b':')?;
        at = next;
        if identity > bytes.len() - at || bytes[at..at + identity].contains(&0) {
            return None;
        }
        at += identity;
        if bytes.get(at) != Some(&b'<') {
            return None;
        }
        at += 1;
        if bytes.get(at) == Some(&b'>') {
            return Some(at + 1);
        }
        loop {
            at = term(bytes, at, depth + 1, nodes)?;
            match bytes.get(at) {
                Some(&b',') => at += 1,
                Some(&b'>') => return Some(at + 1),
                _ => return None,
            }
        }
    }
    for scalar in SCALARS {
        if bytes[at..].starts_with(scalar) {
            return Some(at + scalar.len());
        }
    }
    None
}

/// `None` when the document is the expected one; otherwise a closed reason.
fn verify(bytes: &[u8]) -> Option<&'static str> {
    if bytes.len() > MAX_BYTES || !bytes.starts_with(MAGIC) {
        return Some("malformed");
    }
    let mut at = MAGIC.len();
    let mut records = 0usize;
    while at < bytes.len() {
        if bytes[at] != b'|' {
            return Some("malformed");
        }
        let Some((count, next)) = decimal(bytes, at + 1, b';') else {
            return Some("malformed");
        };
        if count == 0 || count > MAX_FIELDS {
            return Some("malformed");
        }
        at = next;
        let mut starts = [0usize; MAX_FIELDS];
        let mut widths = [0usize; MAX_FIELDS];
        for index in 0..count {
            let Some((width, next)) = decimal(bytes, at, b':') else {
                return Some("malformed");
            };
            at = next;
            if width > bytes.len() - at || bytes[at..at + width].contains(&0) {
                return Some("malformed");
            }
            starts[index] = at;
            widths[index] = width;
            at += width;
            if bytes.get(at) != Some(&b';') {
                return Some("malformed");
            }
            at += 1;
        }
        let field = |index: usize| &bytes[starts[index]..starts[index] + widths[index]];
        let position = if widths[0] == 1 {
            match bytes[starts[0]] {
                b'P' if count == 6 && field(3) == b"data" => Some(5),
                b'R' if count == 4 && field(2) == b"data" => Some(3),
                b'I' if count == 4 => Some(1),
                b'A' if count == 4 => Some(3),
                b'F' if count == 5 => Some(4),
                _ => None,
            }
        } else {
            None
        };
        if let Some(position) = position {
            let selected = field(position);
            let mut nodes = 0usize;
            if term(selected, 0, 0, &mut nodes) != Some(selected.len()) {
                return Some("term");
            }
        }
        records += 1;
        if records > MAX_RECORDS {
            return Some("malformed");
        }
    }
    if records == 0 {
        return Some("malformed");
    }
    if bytes != EXPECTED {
        return Some("mismatch");
    }
    None
}

fn main() {
    let mut arguments = std::env::args_os().skip(1);
    let selected = arguments.next();
    if arguments.next().is_some() {
        eprintln!("usage: consumer [metadata-file]");
        std::process::exit(2);
    }
    let owned = match selected {
        Some(path) => match std::fs::read(&path) {
            Ok(bytes) => bytes,
            Err(error) => {
                eprintln!("cannot read: {error}");
                std::process::exit(2);
            }
        },
        None => EXPECTED.to_vec(),
    };
    match verify(&owned) {
        Some(refusal) => {
            println!("refused:{refusal}");
            std::process::exit(3);
        }
        None => println!("ok"),
    }
}
